arabic text: Pukara sheh ne kahi bar. Zainab
english translation text: The King called out many times: Zainab

arabic text: Khuda hai tera madadgar\nZainab Pukara sheh ne kahi bar
english translation text: God is your Helper\nZainab—thus the King called out many times

arabic text: Na ab hai awn-o-muhammad, na kasimo asghar, Na abjaha\nme hai abbas or na hai akbar, Tumhi ho kafela salar
english translation text: Aun and Muhammad are no longer here, nor Qasim or Asghar; neither Abbas nor Akbar remains\nYou alone are now the leader of the caravan

arabic text: Musibato me tumhe dil pe sabr karna hai, Kadam kadam pe\nbehen tumko sabr karna hai, Wo chahe kufe ka bazar
english translation text: In every calamity, you must hold patience within your heart; at every step, my sister\nYou must remain patient, even in the marketplace of Kufa

arabic text: Hamare baad tume ashkiya sataayenge, Meri sakina ko bhi\nashkiya rulayenge, Ridaaye chinenge kuffar
english translation text: After us, the cruel ones will torment you and make my Sakina weep\nThe disbelievers will snatch away the veils

arabic text: Aseer honga mera laal sayyed-e-sajjad, karenge ehle sitam is\ngharib par bedar, sipar tere hai bimar
english translation text: My son, Sayyed Sajjad, will be made a captive; the oppressors will torment this helpless one\nYou must become the shield of the ailing Imam

arabic text: Tumhare sath haram honge sab rasan bastaa, baraa tawilo\nkatthan honga shaam ka rasta, Na koyi honga madadghar
english translation text: All the women of the sanctuary will be bound in ropes beside you; the road to Shaam will be long and hard\nThere will be no helper

arabic text: Abhi kahaa hai masaaib ke intihaa Zainab, tumhe dikhana\nhai duniya ko hosla Zainab, abhi hai shaam ka bazaar
english translation text: The calamities have not yet reached their end, Zainab; you must show the world your courage\nThe marketplace of Shaam still lies ahead

arabic text: Salaam aap ki azamat pe saniye zehra, Kabul mehshar aasi\nka kijiye nawha, Baraa hai aap ka darbar
english translation text: Peace upon your greatness, O second Zahra; accept this sinner's lament on the Day of Judgement\nYour court is truly exalted

arabic text: Lute huwe mere kumbe ki paas baan tum ho, Asir-e-zulm\nre-or meer karwan tum ho, Tumhi ho hak ki alamdar
english translation text: You are the guardian of my plundered family; though captive under oppression, you lead the caravan\nYou alone are the standard-bearer of truth
